module.purpose: Defines the record-diff data structure and the utilities used to create, reverse, inspect, and consolidate changes in the store system.
module.summary: This module provides a typed representation of added, updated, and removed records, plus operations for inversion, emptiness checks, and sequential squashing. Squashing preserves original record states, chains updates, cancels additions followed by removals, supports optional in-place mutation, and can restrict consolidation to one record type while tracking net entry-count changes.
module.businessContext: Supports store history, synchronization, undo, and change propagation by accurately representing record mutations. Incorrect consolidation can corrupt state transitions or undo behavior.
functions: createEmptyRecordsDiff (~L50-52): Creates a diff with empty added, updated, and removed collections.
reverseRecordsDiff (~L79-90): Produces an inverse diff with updates reversed.
isRecordsDiffEmpty (~L113-115): Determines whether all diff collections contain no records.
hasAnyKey (~L119-122): Checks whether an object has at least one enumerable key.
squashRecordDiffs (~L158-174): Consolidates multiple diffs into one new or mutated result.
squashRecordDiffsMutable (~L195-201): Applies diffs sequentially by mutating a target diff.
squashRecordDiffsMutableByType (~L209-218): Applies only one record type and returns net size change.
squashRecordDiffsMutableImpl (~L220-311): Implements sequential record-state transition and consolidation logic.

mutationOfArg: squashRecordDiffsMutable mutates the target diff's added, updated, and removed collections in place.
squashRecordDiffs mutates the first diff when mutateFirstDiff is true, after copying its existing update tuples.

units.name: createEmptyRecordsDiff

detail.name: createEmptyRecordsDiff
detail.signature: export function createEmptyRecordsDiff<R extends UnknownRecord>(): RecordsDiff<R>
postconditions: Returns a RecordsDiff<R> containing added, updated, and removed properties.
Each returned collection is an empty object.
invariants: The returned diff has no added, updated, or removed records.
edgeCases: The function accepts no arguments and always returns the empty diff structure.
Each invocation returns a newly created diff object with newly created empty collection properties.
detail.summary: Creates and returns an empty RecordsDiff for the requested record type, with separate empty collections for added, updated, and removed records.

units.name: reverseRecordsDiff

detail.name: reverseRecordsDiff
preconditions: diff has added, removed, and updated collections compatible with the RecordsDiff<any> shape.
Each entry in diff.updated is a pair containing an original record and its updated record; the original record provides an id.
postconditions: The returned added collection contains a shallow copy of the input removed collection.
The returned removed collection contains a shallow copy of the input added collection.
The returned updated collection contains each update pair reversed from [from, to] to [to, from], keyed by the original record's id.
Mutating the returned added, removed, or updated collections does not mutate the corresponding input collections.
invariants: Record objects within the collections are preserved by reference; only the collection objects and update pair arrays are newly constructed.
The result always has an empty updated collection before reversed updates are populated.
edgeCases: An empty diff produces empty added, removed, and updated collections.
A diff with added or removed records shallow-copies those collections without deep-cloning their record values.
Each updated entry is keyed in the result by the original record's id, regardless of the source key used to enumerate the input updated collection.
Malformed input that does not provide the expected collections or update-pair structure is not specially handled and may cause a runtime error.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit validation or fallback is performed; runtime errors may occur when the expected RecordsDiff structure is absent or malformed.

detail.summary: Creates an independent reversed records diff by exchanging added and removed records and reversing each updated record pair.

specTests.then: The result has added {b: recordB}, removed {a: recordA}, and updated {"old-id": [newRecord, oldRecord]}.
The result contains three empty collections.

specTests.when: The returned added or removed collection is modified after the call.
specTests.then: The corresponding input collection remains unchanged.

detail.name: squashRecordDiffs
detail.signature: export function squashRecordDiffs<T extends UnknownRecord>(diffs: RecordsDiff<T>[], options?: { mutateFirstDiff?: boolean }): RecordsDiff<T>
preconditions: Each element of diffs is a valid RecordsDiff<T>.
postconditions: Returns a RecordsDiff<T> representing the net effect of the supplied diffs in their input order.
If diffs is empty, returns an empty records diff.
When mutateFirstDiff is true and a first diff exists, the first diff is used as the mutable accumulation target after its updated tuples are copied.
invariants: The returned diff preserves the RecordsDiff<T> shape.
Squashing preserves the effective initial-to-final transition represented by the input diffs.
edgeCases: An empty diffs array returns a newly created empty records diff.
When mutateFirstDiff is true and diffs has no first element, no mutation occurs and an empty records diff is returned.
When mutateFirstDiff is true, updated tuples owned or shared by the first diff are copied before accumulation so tuple mutation does not rely on shared tuple ownership.
stateMutations: When options.mutateFirstDiff is true and a first diff exists, mutates the first RecordsDiff<T> used as the accumulation target.
When options.mutateFirstDiff is true, replaces or copies updated tuples in the first diff before squashing.
detail.summary: Combines an ordered collection of record diffs into one equivalent diff. It can optionally reuse and mutate the first diff as the accumulation target while preserving tuple ownership safety.

specTests.then: the result is an empty RecordsDiff<T>.
the result is an empty RecordsDiff<T> and no first diff is mutated.

units.name: squashRecordDiffsMutable
units.source:
* - Updated records: Chain updates together, preserving the original 'from' state
 * - Removed records: If the record was added in this sequence, cancel both operations
 *
 * The target's `updated` tuples are mutated in place, so the target must own them: start from
 * `createEmptyRecordsDiff()` (or a diff built by earlier squashes into it) rather than a diff whose
 * tuples are shared with another holder.
 *

detail.name: squashRecordDiffsMutable
preconditions: The target diff owns its updated tuples and is not sharing them with another holder.
The target diff is created by createEmptyRecordsDiff() or was produced by earlier mutable squashes into that diff.
postconditions: The target diff represents the combined record changes.
Chained updates preserve the original from-state.
A record added during the sequence and subsequently removed has both operations cancelled.
invariants: Updated tuples in the target may be mutated in place.
The target must retain ownership of any updated tuples that are mutated.
edgeCases: When a record is updated multiple times, the combined update retains the original from-state.
When a record is added and then removed within the squashed sequence, neither operation remains in the resulting diff.
Passing a target whose updated tuples are shared with another holder violates the ownership precondition.
stateMutations: Mutates the target records-diff object, including updated tuples in place.
detail.summary: Mutably squashes record differences into a target diff. Chained updates preserve the original from-state, while an addition followed by removal cancels both operations.

specTests.when: The second diff is squashed into the target.
specTests.then: The resulting update preserves the record's original from-state while incorporating the later update.

specTests.when: The incoming diff is squashed into the target.
specTests.then: The add and remove operations cancel and the record is absent from the resulting diff.

detail.name: squashRecordDiffsMutableByType
detail.summary: Combines record-diff data by record type while mutating the supplied target diff. The resulting target preserves the aggregate changes represented by the input diffs.

units.name: squashRecordDiffsMutableImpl

detail.name: squashRecordDiffsMutableImpl
detail.signature: function squashRecordDiffsMutableImpl<T extends UnknownRecord>(target: RecordsDiff<T>, diffs: RecordsDiff<T>[], fromIndex: number, typeName?: T['typeName']): number
preconditions: target is a mutable RecordsDiff<T> with added, updated, and removed collections.
Every processed item in diffs is a RecordsDiff<T> with compatible record identifiers and record values.
fromIndex identifies the first diff to process.
postconditions: The target represents the net composition of the processed diffs, preserving additions, updates, and removals without mutating the source diffs.
When typeName is provided, only records of that type are incorporated into target.
The return value is the net change in the number of entries represented by target for the selected type; when typeName is omitted, the return value is 0.
invariants: Source diff objects and their records are not mutated.
Existing target updated tuples may be mutated in place rather than replaced.
A record that is added and then removed is eliminated from target additions without leaving a net update.
A record that is removed and then added is restored or represented as an update when its final value differs from its original value.
edgeCases: If fromIndex is equal to or greater than diffs.length, no diffs are processed and the target remains unchanged.
An empty source diff produces no observable target change.
When typeName is supplied, records whose relevant value does not have the selected type name are skipped.
When a selected record already exists in target.added, a later update replaces its added value and removes conflicting target update or removal entries.
When a selected record is re-added with the same value as its prior removal, the removal is cleared without creating an update.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Inputs are not explicitly validated; malformed diff structures may cause ordinary runtime property-access or iteration errors.

stateMutations: Existing target.updated [from, to] tuples may be mutated in place.
detail.summary: Mutates a target records diff by applying source diffs sequentially from the specified index. When a type name is supplied, only matching records are applied and the net entry-count change for that type is returned.

specTests.when: The implementation is invoked with fromIndex 0.
specTests.then: The record is added to target.added and the returned size change is 1.

specTests.when: The implementation is invoked with fromIndex 0.
specTests.then: The target removal is cleared, no update is created, and the returned size change is -1.

specTests.when: The implementation is invoked with that typeName.
specTests.then: Those records are ignored and the target is not changed by them.
